data.title: Laguna Residence
data.about:
Laguna Residence by One Development is a luxurious retreat set amidst Dubai's vibrant skyline in the City of Arabia. Combining sophistication with modern innovation, this exclusive development integrates sustainability, technology, and community focus, making it a standout in Dubai real estate.

Each residence at Laguna offers a unique, flexible layout, from stylish studios to spacious 3-bedroom units crafted to cater to diverse lifestyles. Every unit is thoughtfully designed to deliver luxury, convenience, and privacy, embodying the perfect balance of comfort and elegance.

At Laguna Residence, residents can enjoy over 30 premium amenities, including a private lagoon, infinity pools, indoor and outdoor cinemas, and a dedicated beach area. Fitness enthusiasts have access to a state-of-the-art gym, yoga zone, and aerobics spaces, while the vertical garden provides a serene escape within this bustling city.

characteristics_module.title: First Fully AI-Integrated Residential Development in Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Located in City of Arabia at Dubailand, Laguna Residence offers unmatched connectivity and accessibility to top landmarks, schools, and healthcare facilities.
  • Luxury Lagoon Feature: Home to the UAE’s largest podium lagoon, residents enjoy exclusive access to crystal-clear swimmable waters with panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline.
  • Advanced AI Integration: Laguna Residence is the first in the UAE to integrate AI. It provides personalized home automation and smart services, enhancing convenience and energy efficiency.
  • Diverse Residential Options: From chic studios to spacious 3-bedroom sky homes and duplexes, Laguna Residence offers flexible living spaces tailored to different lifestyles.
  • Over 30 Premium Amenities: Includes indoor and outdoor cinemas, infinity pools, dedicated fitness areas, a private beach, and serene spaces like the vertical garden, making it a holistic lifestyle destination.
  • Investment Potential: A standout in Dubai’s real estate market, Laguna Residence presents a high-value opportunity for both homeowners and investors seeking luxury living.

location_tile.title: Located in the heart of City of Arabia, Dubailand
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Located in City of Arabia, Dubailand, Laguna Residence offers the perfect blend of modern city living and tranquil surroundings. With easy access to key destinations, world-class amenities, and a thriving community, it’s designed for those who seek comfort, convenience, and a lifestyle beyond expectations. Whether you're looking to live or invest, Laguna Residence promises a unique living experience in one of Dubai’s most exciting neighborhoods.

  • 6 Minutes to Gems International School
  • 10 Minutes to Global Village
  • 10 Minutes to Prime Medical Centre
  • 18 Minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 20 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 20 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 30 Minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
